description: Gamma-authored rank-8 projected local-gradient adapter for the external cmix-obias 32-cell terminal bit LSTM, with P/K/O/R/D/S compile-time controls.
hypothesis: A decoder-synchronized gradient collected over the first 256 coded bits of each 512-bit segment can reduce second-half code length when injected into the bit-head input and candidate preactivations.
license_boundary: Gamma overlay plus GPL-3.0 cmix-obias substrate; attribution and corresponding source remain mandatory.

interfaces_exposed: exact integer coder residual -> local bit-head gate tangent -> Q20 Walsh projection -> midpoint gate/logit injection
retired_neighborhoods: Random independent gate maps as the target-bearing D arm.
